comment: labband EXACT-BAND TRAINING scenarios (10 of 16) held-in set for QL training. Held-OUT (test-only): 3 (sun0 both-lamps overshoot — one-step strong-OFF fix), 4 (sun0 hold with irrelevant open blinds), 7 (sun1 strong+blinds overshoot), 11 (sun2 weak+daylight combo overshoot — subtlest, no single actuator is 'too big' on its own), 14 (sun3 deepest overshoot 875 — strong OFF + deploy awning), 16 (sun3 hold with awning already deployed). Held-out ids span all four sun ranks and include FOUR above-band starts (3, 7, 11, 14). Held-in coverage: every sun rank; the strong-lamp trap (2, 6, 10), the awning retract trap (12), the awning deploy move (13), and an in-band hold with the awning active (15), so both awning polarities and both lamp swaps are trainable. Target rank 2 EXACTLY (100-300 lux). Physics: daylight = (Z1Blinds ? 0.50*Sun : 0); if (Awning) daylight *= 0.25; Z1 = 25 + (StrongLamp?400:0) + (WeakLamp?150:0) + daylight.
